name: Photosynthesis - Food Making Process in Plants
Autotrophic vs Heterotrophic Nutrition
description: Autotrophic nutrition is a mode where organisms synthesize food from simple inorganic substances like carbon dioxide and water using light energy. Heterotrophs depend on other organisms for nourishment.

name: Photosynthesis Biochemical Process
description: Photosynthesis is the synthesis of organic carbohydrates from carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, releasing oxygen as a byproduct.

name: Stomata and Gas Exchange
description: Stomata are microscopic pores located primarily on the lower epidermis of leaves, flanked by kidney-shaped guard cells that regulate transpiration and gas exchange.

name: Integers on the Number Line
description: Integers form a collection containing positive natural numbers, zero, and negative numbers. On a horizontal number line, values increase towards the right and decrease towards the left.

name: Multiplication of Negative Integers
description: The product of two positive integers is positive. The product of a positive and a negative integer is negative. The product of two negative integers is positive.
